_comment: ML/training hyperparameter tuning. Copy to ~/mlai-trade/config/mlai-trade-ml-tuning.json when you want local tuning. This file contains no provider credentials. profile=auto chooses cpu/mlx/tch based on the resolved LSTM backend; if an accelerator fails and auto falls back to CPU, the CPU profile is used.

lstm._comment: LSTM profiles. target_mode=regression predicts forward returns. target_mode=direction predicts probability that forward return is above direction_threshold. CPU defaults stay conservative; MLX/TCH profiles can be wider and train longer because accelerator memory/compute is available.

profiles._comment: Each profile supports target_mode, direction_threshold, hidden_dim, epochs, learning_rate, early stopping controls, and early_stopping_sample_size.

cpu._comment: Portable Rust/Rayon profile. Keep modest so small CPU-only machines do not OOM or starve the system.

mlx._comment: Apple Silicon MLX profile. Wider than CPU; early stopping keeps it from overtraining.

tch._comment: Linux/NVIDIA tch/CUDA target profile. It mirrors MLX until CUDA LSTM training is validated on a CUDA host.
